body.text:
Collateral damage is in the tactical map. A new pure-rules crate, `protokill_game_props`, gives furniture a material, integer integrity and intact/cracked/broken states, with the six core props in `definitions/core.json`: glass walls that block movement but not sight, vaultable glass tables, cubicle partitions that topple into the next cell, monitors that spark and disable their desk terminal, and desks and chairs that slide when shoved.

Every source uses the existing systems. A missed shot carries on into the prop behind its target, a melee shove pushes a body into or through glass, a breaching charge blasts props and bodies in range, and alerted guards and charging monsters shoulder furniture aside. Breaks make material-specific noise that guards hear, leave persistent seeded debris (shards that are noisy underfoot and can cut, fallen panels that slow a body, sparking wrecks) and raise the alarm when heard. Inspect names the material and state.

Rendering gives every intact and cracked state its own glyph and colour, a new spark screen effect animates a smashed monitor, and a short shard burst marks a fresh break. The `smash-room` microslice is an open-plan office with a glass meeting room, cubicle rows, desks, monitors and two guards; WASD or arrows move, F fires, E shoves, C throws a charge and R resets. Generated floors furnish office-like rooms behind a debug-menu toggle, with a glyph legend left for the hand-authored facility map.

![The smash-room microslice at the start: glass meeting room, cubicle rows, desks and monitors](https://tangled.org/blob/did:plc:mnfsgqhjrebz5jdw5obnkzt4/bafkreicwun4uge4k4bb2if76s3odjdlrabhbpjd2ut2zsixxaen4qqh3jq)

![A glass wall after one bump: cracked](https://tangled.org/blob/did:plc:mnfsgqhjrebz5jdw5obnkzt4/bafkreigh4iabhzhf7oog5c6fwsjjrpvjpmhe7b2zoisrw4qkslubumpl7a)

![After the fight: shards, a guard thrown through the glass table, a toppled partition panel, desk and chair wreckage, and a sparking monitor](https://tangled.org/blob/did:plc:mnfsgqhjrebz5jdw5obnkzt4/bafkreici4blssoo4emzsbvplvbzieyvtv54digir5uywlxg6cskhokgybi)
